topic: store leather shoes long-term without damaging them
core_question: How should I store leather shoes for months so they don't get damaged?
answer_summary: Clean and condition the shoes, insert shoe trees to hold their shape and absorb moisture, then store them in breathable cloth/dust bags (not sealed plastic) in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
